Bookkeeping Services in Ontario

Monthly bookkeeping services for Ontario small businesses — clean categorization, reconciled accounts, on-time HST and payroll records, and cloud accounting set up properly, handled by a CPA-supervised team at AFFORDABLE flat-fee pricing with no surprise fees.

1

Expense & Revenue Management

Categorize and manage all income and expenses efficiently. Every transaction either supports a deduction or invites a question. We categorize income and expenses consistently and capture the documentation behind each, so your books are both accurate and defensible.

  • We capture and attach the source receipt to each expense through Hubdoc or Dext, meeting CRA's requirement that a deduction be supported by documentation rather than a bank line alone.
  • We confirm the business-use portion of mixed expenses — vehicle, home office, and meals — is recorded correctly, since the personal portion is not deductible and is a common CRA adjustment.
  • We record revenue when it is earned and flag any deposit that is a loan, owner contribution, or transfer rather than income, so unexplained deposits never inflate reported revenue.
  • We confirm the cash or accrual method is applied consistently, since a corporation must report on an accrual basis and switching methods without consistency distorts the books.
  • We keep the categorization clean each month, at a cost-effective flat fee.
2

Bank & Credit Card Reconciliation

Keep accounts accurate with monthly reconciliations. Reconciliation is the control that proves your books match reality. We reconcile every account each month and clear the items that otherwise hide errors, so the numbers you act on are the numbers in the bank.

  • We reconcile each bank and credit card account to its monthly statement, confirming the book balance and the statement balance agree to the cent before the month is closed.
  • We investigate and clear stale outstanding cheques and deposits in transit, so the reconciliation reflects true available funds rather than items that will never clear.
  • We match merchant settlements from Stripe and other processors to bank deposits, separating the gross sale from the processing fee so both are recorded correctly.
  • We identify duplicate and missing transactions during reconciliation, the errors that quietly misstate income and expenses if left to year-end.
  • We complete the monthly reconciliation reliably, with transparent pricing.
3

GST/HST Filing & Remittance

Track, calculate, and submit taxes to CRA on time. HST sits inside your bookkeeping every day, not just at filing. We keep the tax accounts current so the remittance is accurate, on the right schedule, and never a year-end surprise.

  • We confirm your assigned HST filing frequency against CRA's thresholds — annual under $1.5 million, quarterly to $6 million, and monthly above — so you file on the period CRA requires.
  • We keep the HST collected and Input Tax Credit accounts reconciled each month, so the remittance is calculated from clean balances rather than a year-end scramble.
  • We track the filing and payment deadline for your period and remit on time, so no late-filing interest accrues on the HST account.
  • We confirm zero-rated and exempt sales are coded correctly during bookkeeping, so the HST return is accurate when it is prepared.
  • We handle the HST remittance within the monthly service, affordably.
4

Payroll Support & Recordkeeping

Simplify employee payments while staying compliant. Payroll records have to be right the first time, because CRA matches them and employees depend on them. We run the pay cycle and keep the records so remittances, slips, and ROEs are all accurate and on time.

  • We process each pay run through Wagepoint or your payroll platform, recording gross pay, source deductions, and net pay in the books so payroll ties to the general ledger every period.
  • We issue a Record of Employment to Service Canada within five days of an employee's interruption of earnings, the deadline employers most often miss.
  • We maintain the payroll register and remittance record through the year, so the T4 reconciliation at year-end is a confirmation rather than a reconstruction.
  • We track vacation pay accrued and statutory holiday pay in the records, keeping the corporation compliant with Ontario employment standards.
  • We keep the payroll records clean and current, with no surprise fees.
5

Financial Reporting & Insights

Get actionable reports and clear statements monthly or quarterly. Monthly numbers are only useful if you can read them. We deliver reports that show not just what happened but what to do, on a schedule that lets you act while it still matters.

  • We deliver a monthly or quarterly profit and loss and balance sheet from the reconciled books, so you review current results rather than a year-old picture at tax time.
  • We produce class- or location-level reporting where you run more than one revenue stream, so each line of the business shows its own result.
  • We compare actual results to the prior period and flag the variances that matter, turning the report into a decision rather than a record.
  • We track the receivables and payables aging alongside the statements, so cash-flow pressure is visible before it becomes a problem.
  • We deliver the reporting on a set schedule at an affordable flat fee.
6

Cloud-Based Software Setup

Integrate QuickBooks, Xero, or other accounting platforms for seamless bookkeeping. The right setup is the difference between bookkeeping that runs itself and one that fights you. We configure the platform and connect the apps so your books update cleanly with minimal manual entry.

  • We set up QuickBooks Online or Xero with a chart of accounts mapped to GIFI codes, so the file is built for the year-end T2 from the first transaction.
  • We connect the bank feeds and set categorization rules, so recurring transactions code themselves and manual entry drops sharply.
  • We integrate Dext or Hubdoc for receipt capture and Stripe for sales, so source documents and revenue flow into the books automatically.
  • We configure the HST and payroll settings in the platform to match your CRA accounts, so the software calculates tax on the correct basis.
  • We migrate your existing data and train you on the daily workflow, with transparent pricing and no hourly billing.

10 Smart Bookkeeping Strategies That Save Your Business Money

Reconcile Bank Accounts Weekly

Weekly bank reconciliation in your bookkeeping catches duplicate entries, missed deposits, and unauthorized charges before they compound into month-end headaches. Businesses that reconcile only at year-end routinely find thousands in unrecorded expenses and errors that inflate their tax bill or trigger CRA review letters on mismatched revenue.

Categorize Transactions in Real Time

Record and categorize every transaction as it happens rather than batching months of bookkeeping at once. Real-time bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online or Xero ensures your chart of accounts stays current, your GIFI codes map correctly at year-end, and your CPA never has to guess what an uncategorized expense was six months later.

Track HST Input Tax Credits Monthly

Your bookkeeping must capture GST/HST paid on every eligible business purchase as it occurs. Businesses that batch-enter receipts quarterly or annually miss thousands in recoverable input tax credits on their HST return. Consistent bookkeeping of ITCs directly reduces your net HST remittance and improves cash flow every filing period.

Separate Personal and Business Expenses

Mixing personal spending with business transactions is the fastest way to create bookkeeping chaos and trigger a CRA audit. Use a dedicated business bank account and credit card so your bookkeeper can categorize every transaction cleanly. CRA denies deductions when bookkeeping records cannot clearly distinguish personal from business expenditures.

Automate Recurring Bookkeeping Entries

Set up recurring journal entries in your bookkeeping software for fixed monthly costs like rent, insurance, loan payments, and subscription fees. Automation eliminates missed entries, keeps your general ledger accurate between bookkeeping cycles, and ensures your financial statements reflect true monthly expenses without manual catch-up work.

Reconcile Payroll Remittances Every Period

Your bookkeeping must verify that CPP, EI, and income tax deductions remitted to CRA match your payroll records and PD7A statements. Discrepancies between bookkeeping records and CRA's trust account trigger penalties of 10% on repeat offences plus daily compound interest. We reconcile payroll as part of every bookkeeping engagement.

Maintain Receipt Documentation Consistently

CRA can deny any deduction without proper supporting documentation. Your bookkeeping system must attach digital receipts, invoices, and contracts to every transaction. Organized bookkeeping records for vehicle logs under ITA section 67.1, meals at 50%, and home office expenses protect every dollar claimed when CRA requests verification.

Review Accounts Receivable Aging Biweekly

Run your accounts receivable aging report from your bookkeeping software every two weeks. Invoices outstanding over 90 days hurt cash flow and may qualify as bad debt deductions under ITA paragraph 20(1)(p). Proper bookkeeping of uncollectible receivables reduces taxable income and keeps your financial statements accurate for lenders and investors.

Close Your Books Monthly

Monthly bookkeeping closes — where you finalize the general ledger, review the trial balance, and generate income statements — give you real-time visibility into profitability. Businesses that only close books annually miss mid-year tax planning opportunities and face expensive year-end bookkeeping cleanup fees that a simple monthly routine prevents entirely.

Use Cloud Bookkeeping Software

Platforms like QuickBooks Online and Xero automate bank feeds, reduce manual bookkeeping data entry errors, and give your CPA direct access to your records. Cloud-based bookkeeping eliminates file transfers, speeds up year-end financial statement preparation, and ensures your books are always backed up and accessible from anywhere in Ontario or Canada.
